# FindCare UK

> FindCare UK is a free UK healthcare directory where patients search for verified doctors, physiotherapists, sports medicine specialists, osteopaths, chiropractors, psychologists, and nutritionists by condition and location. It shows real-time availability — including emergency and same-day appointments — verified professional credentials (GMC, HCPC, NMC registration), patient reviews, and direct online booking.

## What you can do on FindCare UK

- Search practitioners by condition (e.g. "knee injury", "back pain") plus postcode or town
- Filter by practitioner type, distance, emergency availability, NHS acceptance, video consultations, and language
- Use the symptom checker to find which kind of specialist treats a specific problem
- View verified practitioner profiles with credentials, qualifications, years of experience, and moderated patient reviews
- Book appointments online in real time, or join a waitlist when a practitioner is full
- Send direct enquiries to practitioners

## For healthcare professionals

- Free listing with admin verification of professional registration (GMC / HCPC / NMC / GOsC / GCC / BACP)
- Dashboard to manage profile, weekly recurring availability, bookings, enquiries, and review replies
- Emergency slot flagging to reach patients needing urgent care

## Key pages

- Home / search: /
- Search results: /search
- Symptom checker: /symptom-checker
- Blog & guides: /blog
- FAQ: /faq
- Practitioner registration: /register

## Facts

- Coverage: United Kingdom
- Cost to patients: free
- Practitioner verification: registration numbers checked against the relevant UK professional register before approval
- Booking: real-time slots, no account required for patients
